open_issues.text: PS-SECRET deliberately skips two classes of redact-pattern matches: a lower-case hyphenated word starting with `sk-` (the tail of slugs like `task-development-workflow`; 41 matches in this repository's plans, all false) and the value of a name=value pair that starts with `<`, `$`, `{` or `env://` (placeholders and secret references). The contract says any match of redact.PATTERNS blocks; without the filter the real plans of this repo gave 12 blocks instead of 2 and a migration would have been blocked by false positives (the risk named in the item). Real keys (digits or capitals) still block.
Edited packages/workspace/unit.json (not in the write set): registered the contract urn:swissknifeman:workspace:publish-report in provides.contracts.

Edited packages/workspace/tests/test_projects.py (P1.2 file, not in the write set): replaced the plan folder names `2026.10.01-№1-X` / `2026.10.17-№1-X` by `...-DEMO` because scripts/public-hygiene.py flags a concrete plan ID in a tracked file.
`projects/.gitkeep` (written by init) is allowed by PS-PROJECT-LEVEL; the contract lists no exception for it but the first workspace commit would otherwise be blocked.

open_issues.text: Behaviour choices not fixed by the contract: `--all` without `--publish-safety` is a usage error (exit 2); with --publish-safety only the report is printed (no structural checks); a large binary above max_tracked_bytes gets reason `size`; local-only files are not content-scanned but their secret file names still block; a path with a backslash is refused by localonly.update (portable index); update() raises ValueError for a missing or symlinked file.

For P3.2/P4.2: localonly.update/rebuild_exclude and safety.* do not take git.lock; the caller must hold gitutil.git_lock (flock on a second descriptor in the same process would deadlock). The flow is safety.check -> localonly.entries_by_project -> update per project -> rebuild_exclude(ws_root, device_id); tracked files that became local-only are only reported (PS-TRACKED-LOCAL-ONLY), removal from the index is left to sync.

summary: Publish-safety for the workspace. safety.py: rules PS-SECRET (redact patterns on UTF-8 text within max_tracked_bytes, secret file names), PS-MANIFEST-PATH, PS-SYMLINK, PS-TOP-LEVEL, PS-PROJECT-LEVEL (block), PS-EXECUTABLE, PS-HOME-PATH, PS-TRACKED-LOCAL-ONLY (warn), PS-SIZE and PS-BINARY (local-only), Report with verdict and to_dict (publish-report/v1), changed_paths (git status --porcelain=v2 -z), all_paths, scan, check, load_settings from [workspace.publish]; a secret is never printed (rule, path, line, mask). localonly.py: update (index projects/<id>/local-only.json: replaces the entries of one device, keeps the others, atomic, written only on change), read, entries_by_project, device_paths, rebuild_exclude (whole block between '# skm:local-only begin/end' in .git/info/exclude, other lines untouched, begin without end refused, escaped patterns anchored at the workspace root). doctor.publish_safety and `workspace doctor --publish-safety [--all] [--json]` (exit 1 and PUBLISH_BLOCKED on stderr when a rule blocks; --all alone is exit 2). Schema schemas/publish-report/v1. README and CHANGELOG updated. Tests: tests/test_safety.py (38 tests) and tests/test_localonly.py (18 tests) with fixtures of every rule; whole workspace suite 137 tests OK (unittest discover); ecosystem-units check, standalone workspace and aicore, public-hygiene (0 violations), test-event-contracts, render --check pass. A run of `doctor --publish-safety --all` over a copy of this repository's plans (1068 files) gave 2 PS-SECRET blocks (example code in research/*.md) and 59 PS-HOME-PATH warnings after the false-positive filters.
